data.heading: Everything a local business needs to turn demand into customers.
data.lede: Three services, one team, one set of numbers. Buy the one you need now. The others make it work harder when you're ready.

data.link_label: Underneath all three: tracking that ties every call and form to what paid for it

data.heading: Leads teach the ads. Ads teach the site.
data.aside: Split web, search and ads across three vendors and this loop breaks at every hand-off. Nobody sends the sold-lead data back. Nobody rewrites the page the ad points at. One team closes it.

items.title: Mark a lead sold or lost.
items.body: That verdict goes back to Google and Meta as a real conversion, so the bidding learns to find customers instead of form fills.

items.title: The page that converts becomes the ad.
items.body: Same promise on both sides of the click, because the same team owns both sides.

items.title: A page losing people gets flagged and fixed.
items.body: We see it in the ad data the day it starts, redraft the page, and it's live the same week.

items.title: Buy one service
items.body: Ads only, or a website only, is a normal way to start. Most engagements do.

items.title: Buy two
items.body: Web and search together, since the same pages do both jobs. Or ads and web, so the landing page and the campaign match.

items.title: Buy the system
items.body: All three, so the loop closes: sold leads teach the ads, the ads teach the site, the site feeds search.

data.heading: No mystery about what happens next.

phases.title: We look
phases.body: Read-only access to the accounts and the site. We go through them and write up what we find, with the money attached.
items: You keep the findings, hired or not
A person walks you through it

phases.title: We set up
phases.body: Accounts connected, tracking verified, spend limits and approval rules set with you before anything runs.
items: Your accounts stay in your name

phases.title: We run it
phases.body: The account gets worked every day. Changes carry their evidence, a named person approves them, and you get one plain-English email a week.
items: Leads on your phone as they arrive

data.heading: Who this is for, and who it isn't.
never: Anyone who wants a vendor to execute a plan they've already written
Businesses that can't take the calls a working campaign produces
always: Local and multi-location businesses where a phone call or a form is the sale
Law firms, medical and dental practices, mortgage and insurance
Home services and trades, storage and moving, clinics and wellness
Owners who want to see the numbers, not just a monthly PDF
data.note: We take accountability for the outcome, which means having opinions about the plan.

data.heading: Request a marketing audit.
